name: scaffold-hbar-custos
description: A margin engine the Hedera network keeps: an HBAR-USD perpetual exchange whose liquidations and funding are run by the Hedera Schedule Service (HIP-1215), priced by Chainlink, cross-checked by Supra, with SaucerSwap for HBAR deposits and a self-funding keeper.

steps.text: The keeper runs on Hedera Schedule Service, which local chains and Foundry forks don't have. Unit tests use a mock; the live market runs on Hedera testnet.

steps.label: Run the unit and invariant tests

sections.title: Run your own market on testnet

steps.label: Generate or import a deployer account
Fund it with testnet HBAR (deploy puts 40 HBAR in the keeper reserve by default; the demo swaps 50 more)
Deploy PriceGuard, LiquidityPool and PerpMarket, and fund the keeper
Book the keeper's first tick: from here the network runs it
Optional: seed the pool and open a 50x position that a small move liquidates

sections.title: Watch the network keep the books

steps.text: Read AGENTS.md before extending it: adding a market, reusing the engine for lending, or adding a new keeper job.
